主要内容: NICHOLAS FINANCIAL INC held its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders on August 23, 2018. The voting results for the election of directors included Robin J. Hastings with 4,807,660 votes, Jeffrey Royal with 4,828,312 votes, and Douglas Marohn with 4,853,670 votes. Adam Peterson and Jeremy Zhu were re-elected as directors. The company also ratified the appointment of RSM US, LLP as independent auditors and conducted an advisory vote on executive compensation.
